svg.desc: Role: Full-stack & AI Engineer. Focus: Document AI · Recommenders · Realtime Apps. Base: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Class: Grand Magus · Arcane. Awakened: 2023-12-15. Graduating CS student at IU — VNUHCM. I build production systems: a marketplace with 12 recommendation models, an AI realtime kanban board, and OCR tooling for Vietnamese legal documents.
